lastCompletedStory.title: Migrate the implementer worker self-push into the sidecar (make the invariant true)

nextStoryContext: US-003 removed the worker self-push (send-keys Step B) from both agent files and the template mirror, regenerated src/vendor/_generated.ts, and wired notifyOrchestrator calls in src/supervisor/loop.ts at all genuine-terminal-advance sites (else-branch for real advance, PRD_COMPLETE, supervisor-finalize pass, and every terminal-blocked return). The two new discriminating tests in test/supervisor/loop.test.ts prove: (1) notify fires exactly once on a fresh advance, (2) notify fires zero times on a no-progress re-confirmation retry. The sidecar is now the sole pusher of implementer narration lines to the orchestrator pane. All 1372 tests pass.
